body: The owner says Williams sounds are distinctive and must match the originals. Proposed playbook change: drop 'audio not yet measured' as n/a when closing a game. Every sound row needs measured breakpoints, an original-over-ours spectrogram, and a stored feature target (duration; pitch, centroid and flatness at each breakpoint; step and warble rates) checked by a cargo test. Made in VectorCraft first, then copied.
summary: Proposal from the owner: a game closes only once its sounds are measured and matched
